events.description: Called when the user confirms, just before the dialog closes.
events.name: onConfirm

events.description: Called when the user refuses: the cancel button, Escape or the Android back button, or a press outside.
events.name: onCancel

events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

props.description: The question, required: it names the dialog for assistive technology, so word it as a decision.
props.name: title

props.description: What the decision does, read out with the dialog; text, because it is what the dialog is described by.
props.name: description

props.description: Anything more the decision needs, shown under the description: a field to type a name into, say.
props.name: children

props.description: The label of the button that agrees, in the app's language, for example "Delete project".
props.name: confirmLabel

props.description: The label of the button that refuses, in the app's language, for example "Keep project". On web it takes focus first; on native it comes first in reading order.
props.name: cancelLabel

props.description: True to refuse the confirming press until the decision is ready, as when the user must still type a name.
props.name: isConfirmDisabled

props.description:
True, the default, to close the overlay on a press outside it (the backdrop on a modal, a drawer and a dialog).
Set false for a step the user must finish, and give the content its own close control.
props.name: isDismissable

props.description:
True to keep the Escape key from closing the overlay. It is for a flow with unsaved work or a nested overlay
open, so set it only with `isDismissable` false or a close control in reach. Native has no Escape key, so it
stays unread there unless a component's own page says it maps to the Android back button.
props.name: isKeyboardDismissDisabled

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen

props.description: The kind of message. Defaults to `default`; `danger` and `warning` are announced at once.
props.name: tone

props.description: An icon in place of the tone's own, or `false` for none. Left out, the tone's icon is drawn.
props.name: icon

props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.
props.name: aria-describedby

props.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description for the
object.
props.name: aria-details

props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.
props.name: aria-label

props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.
props.name: aria-labelledby

props.description:
The CSS [className](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/className) for the
element.
props.name: className

props.description:
The element's unique identifier. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/id).
props.name: id

props.description:
Whether the dialog is currently performing an entry animation. Focus is not moved into the
dialog until the animation completes, since moving the screen reader cursor may cause scrolling
that interrupts the animation.
props.name: isEntering

props.description:
Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
This allows rendering existing components with built-in styles and behaviors
such as router links, animation libraries, and pre-styled components.

Requirements:

- You must render the expected element type (e.g. if `<button>` is expected, you cannot render an
  `<a>`).
- Only a single root DOM element can be rendered (no fragments).
- You must pass through props and ref to the underlying DOM element, merging with your own prop
  as appropriate.
props.name: render

props.description:
A slot name for the component. Slots allow the component to receive props from a parent
component. An explicit `null` value indicates that the local props completely override all
props received from a parent.
props.name: slot

props.description:
The inline [style](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/style) for the
element.
props.name: style

slots.description: Trigger element that opens the alert dialog
slots.name: .alert-dialog__trigger

slots.description: Header section for icon and title
slots.name: .alert-dialog__header
